answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because ember only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, quill is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any ferrous approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
